privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.tagline: We protect your information when you browse our website or contact us about vegetarian/vegan meals, catering, or events.

quickPoints.title: Clear purpose
quickPoints.description: We collect only what we need to respond to you, send quotes, handle catering/orders, and improve your experience.

quickPoints.title: No selling data
quickPoints.description: We never sell personal data. Sharing, when needed, is limited to trusted providers that help us operate.

quickPoints.title: Your control
quickPoints.description: You may request access, corrections, deletion, or withdraw consent at any time.

quickPoints.title: Layered security
quickPoints.description: Restricted internal access plus technical and organizational safeguards to reduce risk.

sections.title: 1. Scope & applicability
sections.summary: This policy covers information we collect whenever you interact with Achi Vegan House.
items: Applies when you visit our website, submit contact forms, call, email, message us on social channels, or speak with us at the restaurant.
By using the site or sharing information, you agree to the terms in this policy.

sections.title: 2. Information we collect
items: Information you provide: name, email, phone number, inquiry details, order/service information, feedback, or reviews.
Technical data collected automatically: IP address, browser, device, operating system, entry/exit pages, time on page, and basic interactions.
Cookies and similar technologies to remember preferences and measure site performance.

sections.title: 3. How we use your information
items: Respond to inquiries, send quotes, and confirm or follow up on orders or catering.
Improve content speed, reliability, and experience on our website.
Send important updates (for example: opening hours changes, menu updates, or order follow-ups).
Detect and prevent fraud or misuse of our systems.

sections.title: 4. Cookies & tracking
items: We use cookies to remember preferences, measure engagement, and optimize site performance.
You can disable cookies in your browser. Some features may be limited when cookies are turned off.

sections.title: 5. Sharing your information
items: We do not sell personal data to third parties.
We may share data with service providers (hosting, analytics, payment, marketing tools) to run and improve the site.
We may share with partners or contractors related to your order/service when necessary, under confidentiality obligations.
We comply with lawful requests from authorities when required.

sections.title: 6. Data security
items: We apply technical and organizational measures to prevent unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure.
Internal access to personal data is limited based on role and business need.
While we strive for security, no method of transmission or storage is absolutely secure.

sections.title: 7. Data retention
items: We keep data only as long as needed to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected.
We delete or anonymize data upon request unless a longer retention period is required by law.

sections.title: 8. Your rights
items: Request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data.
Withdraw consent or object to certain processing activities.
Submit a request via the contact details below; we respond within a reasonable time.

sections.title: 9. Third-party links
items: Our site may link to external websites or services.
We are not responsible for their content or privacy practices. Please review their policies separately.

sections.title: 10. Children's privacy
items: Our site is not intended for children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect data from them.
If you believe we hold data about a child, please contact us so we can remove it promptly.

sections.title: 11. Changes to this policy
items: We may update this policy and will post the latest version on this page.
We encourage you to review it periodically. Last updated: Jan 13, 2026.

hero.title: To Bring Man & Nature Closer
hero.description: Hasake Zoo & Habitat Solutions is an internationally acclaimed company specializing in zoo consultancy, wildlife habitat design, and animal logistics. With over 20 years of combined expertise, we create facilities that inspire conservation and connect people with wildlife.

whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.description1: Hasake Zoo & Habitat Solutions was established through the merger of Goatrade Wildlife Park Co., Ltd. and HKS Designer and Consultant International Co., Ltd., bringing together over 20 years of combined expertise in animal welfare, conservation, and sustainable zoo development.
whoWeAre.description2: Our mission is simple yet profound: "To Bring Man & Nature Closer." We believe that well-designed wildlife facilities can play a crucial role in conservation education, species preservation, and fostering a deeper connection between humans and the natural world.

history.title: Our History
history.subtitle: Two legacy companies united by a shared passion for wildlife conservation.
history.goatradeDesc: Originally established as Goatrade Farming Co., Ltd., our animal transportation division has been at the forefront of professional wildlife logistics for over two decades. We specialize in the legal and ethical transportation of wildlife, adhering strictly to CITES regulations. Our expertise in designing and manufacturing IATA-standard transport crates has made us a trusted partner for zoos, wildlife parks, and conservation organizations worldwide.
history.hksDesc: HKS Designer and Consultant International Co., Ltd. was established in Bangkok, Thailand, with a vision to revolutionize zoo design and animal habitat development in Asia. Over the years, HKS has designed and implemented numerous award-winning projects across Thailand, Vietnam, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, and Myanmar.

expertise.title: Our Expertise
expertise.subtitle: Comprehensive solutions for wildlife conservation and zoo management.
expertise.zooDesignDesc: Comprehensive zoo design services from concept development to detailed architectural drawings, prioritizing animal welfare, visitor experience, and operational efficiency.
expertise.transportDesc: Safe animal transport across continents with IATA-standard crate design, CITES documentation, airline coordination, veterinary support, and door-to-door logistics management.
expertise.welfareDesc: Comprehensive environmental enrichment programs that stimulate natural behaviors and improve animal welfare, based on scientific research and best practices from leading zoos.
expertise.breedingDesc: Support for developing and managing conservation breeding programs for endangered species, including genetic management consultation and coordination with international programs.
expertise.exchangeDesc: Facilitating animal exchanges between zoos worldwide, helping institutions manage their collections sustainably while supporting global conservation goals.
expertise.educationDesc: Educational animal presentations combining entertainment with conservation messaging, reaching millions of visitors with positive impact on conservation awareness.

approach.title: Our Approach
approach.scienceDesc: Every project is grounded in scientific research. We study animal behavior, ecology, and welfare science to create habitats that meet both biological and psychological needs.
approach.sustainDesc: We integrate sustainable practices into all projects, from water management systems to renewable energy solutions, minimizing environmental impact while maximizing conservation impact.
approach.culturalDesc: With offices across Asia, we incorporate local culture and traditions into our designs while maintaining international standards.
approach.collabDesc: We work closely with clients, architects, veterinarians, and animal care teams to ensure every project meets its goals through a consultative and transparent approach.

globalReach.title: Our Global Reach
globalReach.subtitle: Headquartered in Bangkok with regional offices across Asia.
globalReach.thailand: Thailand: Journey to the Jungle (Khao Kheow), Australian Kingdom (Khon Kaen Zoo), Lion Exhibit
globalReach.vietnam: Vietnam: Tram Chim National Park, FLC Safari Park, Saigon Zoo Bird Show, numerous playground & landscape projects
globalReach.india: India: Walk-through aviaries, reptile exhibits, conservation programs
globalReach.indonesia: Indonesia: Theme parks and wildlife facilities
globalReach.myanmar: Myanmar: Animal facilities and zoo consultation
globalReach.malaysia: Malaysia: Various design and consultation projects

values.title: Our Values
values.innovationDesc: We constantly seek new and better ways to design wildlife facilities and care for animals.
values.integrityDesc: We operate with honesty and transparency in all our dealings.
values.collaborationDesc: We believe the best results come from working together with clients and partners.
values.compassionDesc: We care deeply about animal welfare and environmental conservation.
values.excellenceDesc: We strive for the highest quality in everything we do.

certifications.title: Certifications & Memberships
certifications.item1: Member of World Association of Zoos and Aquariums (WAZA)
certifications.item3: IATA certified for live animal transportation

commitment.title: Our Commitment
commitment.welfareDesc: Animal welfare is our top priority. Every design decision, every transport plan, every enrichment program is developed with the animal's physical and psychological well-being at the forefront.
commitment.conservationDesc: We believe zoos and wildlife parks have a responsibility to contribute to conservation. We help our clients develop programs that support species preservation, habitat protection, and public education.
commitment.excellenceDesc: We set high standards for ourselves and continually strive to improve, staying current with the latest research, technologies, and best practices.
commitment.clientsDesc: We are committed to delivering projects on time, within budget, and exceeding expectations. Our success is measured by our clients' satisfaction.

vision.title: Our Vision for the Future
vision.description: We envision a world where every zoo and wildlife park serves as a center for conservation, education, and research. Through innovation, collaboration, and unwavering commitment to animal welfare, we will continue to push the boundaries of what's possible in zoo design and wildlife management.
